text: Ana: Quick pass on the compact Error Panel — uploaded a new frame in Figma (link) showing a tighter header and action reflow. Sam: Thanks — what are the main UX changes? Ana: Moved Export into the kebab (⋯) to reduce accidental clicks. Added a small inline pill next to the timestamp to surface a copyable Request ID. Reduced vertical padding in the list. Mike: Runtime note: clipboard action should use `navigator.clipboard.writeText()` with a selection fallback for older browsers. Also add a short debounce so rapid clicks don't spam telemetry. Tariq: A11y nits: the ID pill must be keyboard-focusable and have `aria-label="Copy request id"`. The confirmation should be announced — e.g. an sr-only node with `aria-live="polite"` that reads “Request ID copied”. Visible focus ring is required. Jess: Tab order concern — the kebab shouldn't break the logical flow. If actions are [Share, Open in Trace, Export], keep kebab last in the group so tabbing reads primary actions first. When kebab menu opens, trap focus inside until closed. Sam: Quick lexicon decision: we currently use “Correlation ID” elsewhere — should this panel use the same term or switch to “Request ID” for clarity? Ana: I prefer “Request ID” here — more approachable for non-technical users. Short copy: use “Copy request id”. Tariq: Agree with Ana. If people search for correlation id we'll add a tooltip: “Also known as correlation id”. Mike: Implementation details: make the pill a ` Request ID copied to clipboard ``` Ana: About the Export label — proposals: “Export snapshot”, “Download snapshot”, “Download trace snapshot”. Thoughts? Sam: Short + clear wins. Leaning to “Export snapshot” so it matches other product copy. Jess: From accessibility/clarity, “Download trace snapshot” is the most descriptive — screen reader users benefit from the context. Tariq: If we use the shorter label visually, the kebab tooltip can include the longer description. Mike: One more runtime corner: large traces will trigger an async export. Show progress state on the kebab menu item and disable it while packaging, with a keyboard-accessible status message. Ana: Cool, I'll update the frame: switch label to “Export snapshot” visually, add tooltip with the long form, make the copy pill a focusable button and include the sr-only success message. I'll push a2 by EOD. Sam: I'll consolidate final copy options and send to localization. Thanks all :thumbsup: Tariq: Also flag for QA: keyboard nav, NVDA readout, and color-contrast of the pill (needs 4.5:1). Mike: Filed a follow-up runtime task for clipboard fallback and export progress handling. Jess: Noted — will check focus management in the interaction spec. Ana: Perfect — will annotate the figma with notes and link back when ready.
